newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Monday were at a standstill, with no sales reported, according to market sources.

Inquiry was extremely light. Packer bids were not quoted but they were expected to surface at $113.00 to $114.00 on a dressed basis. Owners were asking $116.00/dressed, steady with last week's top prices.
On a live basis, bids were expected to be quoted at $71.00 to $72.00 per cwt against asking levels at $73.00.
This week's showlist was up slightly, compared with last week, and still short on finished cattle, the sources said.
